svg.title: Two plans from the same start: a straight line that falls short, and a curve planned back from a vision the champion holds.
svg.desc: Two lines over the same time, both starting from today at the lower left. The vision sits at the upper right, highlighted: the champion holds it. The first line, planned forward, climbs in a straight line and ends, on time, about halfway up. The gap between its end and the vision is shaded: still short. The second, planned back from the vision, stays low at first, while new investments come online, crosses the straight line about two thirds of the way along, then climbs steeply toward the vision, if the investments pay off.

g.text: slow while new investments come online,
